message.reasoning_content: The kernel stores h in fp16 each step. Workload: a=0.99, b~0.01±0.001, t=640. Reference h converges to b/(1-a) ≈ 0.01*1 =1... Actually fixed point h* = b/(1-0.99)=b*100 ≈ 1.0. fp16 has ~2^-11 relative precision ≈ 5e-4, well within 0.003 budget. Likely passes. Record claim and run probe.
